UnitStatement: DEL-12-02 defines redaction and export-control behavior for public reports, public examples, shared model exports, downstream-tool exports, and local/private exports.
The redaction control is local-first and operates on an export/report representation.
The control does not mutate source project data, move quarantine material, transmit data to a cloud service, decide legal rights, or provide professional approval.
Redaction decisions use explicit metadata only.
The control does not infer sensitivity from engineering-looking values, filenames, text patterns, or hidden guesses.
A value-bearing export field should carry field_class, privacy_classification, redistribution_status, review_status, and provenance where the source is not self-evident public metadata.

The control consumes explicit storage/privacy indicators when present: contains_payload, payload_present, secret_material_present, direct_sql_access, storage-bypass flags, cloud_or_network_reference, concrete_path_present, symbolic path/locality metadata, and local/private intent metadata.
Storage/privacy indicators are treated as metadata gates only.
Storage/privacy indicators do not authorize payload storage, direct SQLite access, raw SQL access, network or cloud behavior, concrete user-path disclosure, secret handling, or source-data mutation.
Absent, unknown, TBD, pending, rejected, or quarantined metadata does not silently pass into public/shared exports; it produces warning, redaction, or blocking behavior.
For public_report context: include public metadata and invented public examples; redact private or unresolved values; block suspected protected content and professional-boundary claims.
For public_example context: same handling as public_report; examples must be invented or public-permissive reviewed content.
For shared_model context: redact private project, material, component, rule-pack, owner-standard, design-basis, path, and secret-like data unless metadata supports sharing.
For downstream_tool context: redact unresolved or private values unless explicit metadata supports the handoff.
For local_private context: retain private values only when explicit local/private user intent is recorded, and emit warning findings.

The default protected classes are private project data, private material data, private component data, private rule-pack data, owner-standard data, company design-basis data, path data, secret-like data, suspected protected content, and unresolved provenance or redistribution status.

Safe metadata such as IDs, versions, checksums, source notes, warning summaries, schema versions, and provenance summaries may remain visible where metadata marks them public or invented public examples.
Action include: export the field as-is because metadata permits it.
Action warning_only: retain the value and emit a warning, limited to local/private exports with explicit intent or unresolved metadata in local/private context.
Action redact_value: replace the field value or text with a redaction marker while keeping non-sensitive metadata.
Action redact_field: keep only minimal field identity and classification metadata.
Action omit_field: remove the field from the export representation.
Action block_export: mark the export as blocked until metadata, rights, protected-content, or professional-boundary issues are resolved.
Findings are machine-readable and include a reason code, finding class, severity, affected path, action, message, and remediation.
Expected finding classes include IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING, PRIVATE_DATA_WARNING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, STORAGE_BOUNDARY_WARNING, and PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_WARNING.

Unknown provenance, unknown redistribution status, missing metadata, rejected review status, quarantined review status, suspected protected content, and professional-boundary claims are explicit findings.
A clean redaction run is review evidence only, not a legal or professional clearance.
Storage/privacy hardening adds blocking findings for payload material, explicit secret-material flags, cloud or network references, direct SQL or raw SQLite access, and storage-bypass metadata.
Concrete path indicators are reduced to a redacted representation so concrete user paths are not emitted.
The implementation copies the export/report representation before applying redaction.
Source project models, private libraries, rule packs, report inputs, and local storage paths are not modified by this control.
DEL-12-02 should be checked for schema traceability to DEL-12-02, PKG-12, SOW-040, and OBJ-010.
DEL-12-02 should be checked for explicit-metadata-only classification.
DEL-12-02 should be checked for redaction of private project, material, component, rule-pack, owner-standard, company design-basis, path, and secret-like values in public/shared exports.
DEL-12-02 should be checked for warnings or redaction for missing provenance and unknown redistribution.

DEL-12-02 should be checked for blocking or redaction for payload material, secret-material flags, cloud/network references, direct SQL/raw SQLite access, storage bypass markers, and concrete path indicators.
DEL-12-02 should be checked for explicit local/private intent before retaining private values.

DEL-12-02 should be checked for no cloud transmission, secret handling, source mutation, protected standards content, non-invented private payloads, concrete user paths, direct SQL/storage bypass, or professional-authority assertions.
